```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  out.width = "100%"
)

# ── Dependencies ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(DT)
  library(scales)
  library(ggrepel)
})

# ── Palette and theme ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Tableau_10 swatch, shared with the other reports of the pipeline.
if (requireNamespace("paletteer", quietly = TRUE)) {
  .tableau10 <- as.character(paletteer::paletteer_d("ggthemes::Tableau_10"))
} else {
  .tableau10 <- c(
    "#4E79A7", "#F28E2B", "#E15759", "#76B7B2", "#59A14F",
    "#EDC948", "#B07AA1", "#FF9DA7", "#9C755F", "#BAB0AC"
  )
}
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y  = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(l = 20, r = 20)),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12)),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 5)),
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey40", hjust = 0, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 10))
  )
)

# ── Seed and helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Seed for the subsamples and jitter of the plots (params$seed, 1998 when unset).
seed_val <- if (exists("params") && !is.null(params$seed) && nzchar(as.character(params$seed))) as.integer(params$seed) else 1998
set.seed(seed_val)

# Correlation that returns NA, not an error, when fewer than 3 complete pairs remain, so that
# sections of sparse optional modules do not fail.
safe_cor <- function(x, y, method = "pearson") {
  ok <- complete.cases(x, y)
  if (sum(ok) < 3) return(NA_real_)
  cor(x[ok], y[ok], method = method)
}

```

```{r load-data}
pos_df  <- read_tsv(params$position_scores_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
gene_df <- read_tsv(params$gene_scores_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
.metadata <- file.path(dirname(params$gene_scores_file),"gene_evidence_metadata.json")
if(file.exists(.metadata)) {
 .m <- jsonlite::read_json(.metadata,simplifyVector=TRUE)
 params$evidence_p_threshold <- .m$nominal_threshold
 params$evidence_fdr_threshold <- .m$fdr_threshold
}
corr_df <- read_tsv(params$gene_corr_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Force numeric types for columns that may be guessed as character due to leading NAs or empty tables
.num_cols_pos <- c(
  "CAAS_score", "asr_score", "asr_path_score", "p.emp", "p.adj_bh",
  "p.emp_fact", "p.adj_bh_fact", "q_emp", "fubar_prob", "pos_var_mean",
  "fade_site_bf", "max_site_bf", "alpha", "beta", "omega",
  "fold_change", "delta_loglik"
)
for (.cn in intersect(.num_cols_pos, names(pos_df))) {
  pos_df[[.cn]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pos_df[[.cn]]))
}

.int_cols_pos <- c("Position", "n_hypotheses", "n_top_species", "n_bottom_species")
for (.cn in intersect(.int_cols_pos, names(pos_df))) {
  pos_df[[.cn]] <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos_df[[.cn]]))
}
if ("Gene" %in% names(pos_df)) pos_df$Gene <- as.character(pos_df$Gene)
if ("side" %in% names(pos_df)) pos_df$side <- as.character(pos_df$side)

.num_cols_gene <- c(
  "gene_caas_score", "gene_caas_score_top", "gene_caas_score_bottom",
  "accum_p", "accum_fdr", "accum_score",
  "rer_min_pval", "rer_rho", "rer_p.adj", "ami_score", "fcs_score",
  "fade_max_bf_top", "fade_max_bf_bottom"
)
for (.cn in intersect(.num_cols_gene, names(gene_df))) {
  gene_df[[.cn]] <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gene_df[[.cn]]))
}

.int_cols_gene <- c("n_positions", "n_positions_top", "n_positions_bottom")
for (.cn in intersect(.int_cols_gene, names(gene_df))) {
  gene_df[[.cn]] <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(gene_df[[.cn]]))
}
if ("Gene" %in% names(gene_df)) gene_df$Gene <- as.character(gene_df$Gene)

# position_scores.tsv carries no per-row factor, and CAAS_score is already the asr_path_score of the position.
# `asr_score` is aliased to asr_path_score when the table has it and to CAAS_score otherwise, so
# that the panels below always find the column.
if (!"asr_score" %in% names(pos_df)) {
  pos_df$asr_score <- if ("asr_path_score" %in% names(pos_df) && any(!is.na(pos_df$asr_path_score))) {
    pos_df$asr_path_score
  } else {
    pos_df$CAAS_score
  }
}

# Provisional availability flags from gene_df; has_rand and has_rer are set again from the same
# columns further down.
has_rand <- "accum_p" %in% names(gene_df) && any(!is.na(gene_df$accum_p))
has_rer  <- "rer_min_pval"    %in% names(gene_df) && any(!is.na(gene_df$rer_min_pval)) &&
            "rer_rho"         %in% names(gene_df)

.file_ok <- function(p) !is.null(p) && !is.na(p) && nchar(p) > 0 && file.exists(p)

has_genomic       <- .file_ok(params$genomic_info_file)
# Position-level null of the permulation: per null cycle and direction, the scored entries, the genes that have one and
# the histogram of their scores (cycle_summary.tsv, cycle_hist.tsv of CAAS_CORE_MERGE_REDUCE).
has_pos_null      <- .file_ok(params$null_summary_file) && .file_ok(params$null_hist_file) &&
                     length(readLines(params$null_summary_file, n = 2L)) >= 2L
has_filtered      <- .file_ok(params$filtered_discovery_file) # observed asr_path_score
# FADE site (position-level) data: use top direction if available, otherwise try bottom
has_fade_pos      <- .file_ok(params$fade_site_top_file) || .file_ok(params$fade_site_bot_file)
# FADE gene-level data: computed by scoring_compute.R from fade_summary_top/bottom.tsv,
# independently of the site-level tables.
has_fade_gene     <- any(c("fade_max_bf_top", "fade_max_bf_bottom") %in% names(gene_df))
# Initialized FALSE here so later chunks with eval=has_fade_any don't crash when
# the fade-pos-setup chunk is skipped (has_fade_pos == FALSE).
has_fade_top <- FALSE
has_fade_bot <- FALSE
has_fade_any <- FALSE

if (has_genomic) {
  # Format: gene, chr, start, end, length  (no header assumed; detect if header present)
  genomic_raw <- read_tsv(params$genomic_info_file,
                          col_names = c("Gene", "chr", "gene_start", "gene_end", "gene_length"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
  # Drop header row if first cell is literally "gene" or "Gene"
  if (tolower(genomic_raw$Gene[1]) == "gene") genomic_raw <- genomic_raw[-1, ]
  genomic_raw <- genomic_raw %>%
    mutate(
      gene_start  = as.integer(gene_start),
      gene_end    = as.integer(gene_end),
      gene_length = as.integer(gene_length),
      gene_mid    = as.integer((gene_start + gene_end) / 2L)
    )
} else {
  genomic_raw <- NULL
}

# ── RERConverge availability ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
has_rer <- "rer_min_pval" %in% names(gene_df) &&
           any(!is.na(gene_df$rer_min_pval)) &&
           "rer_rho" %in% names(gene_df)

# ── Directional position subsets (side, from per-side position_scores) ────────
pos_top    <- pos_df %>% filter(side == "top")
pos_bottom <- pos_df %>% filter(side == "bottom")

# ── Directional gene CAAS scores ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Read from gene_scores.tsv (scoring_compute.R section 4a), never recomputed here, so the report
# cannot disagree with the pipeline's own output. gene_caas_top and gene_caas_bot are local
# aliases that keep the later code short.
.num_col <- function(col) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(if (col %in% names(gene_df)) gene_df[[col]] else rep(NA_real_, nrow(gene_df))))
gene_df$gene_caas_top <- .num_col("gene_caas_score_top")
gene_df$gene_caas_bot <- .num_col("gene_caas_score_bottom")

# ── Gene-level accumulation significance ──────────────────────────────────────
# Accumulation is represented by its exact hypergeometric p-value (accum_p),
# with BH FDR (accum_fdr) and accum_significant (accum_fdr < 0.05).
has_accum_score <- "accum_p" %in% names(gene_df) && any(!is.na(gene_df$accum_p))
has_rand <- has_accum_score

# ── Gene-level direction assignment ───────────────────────────────────────────
# Assign direction to each gene from its top-scoring position
gene_direction_df <- pos_df %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  slice_max(CAAS_score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Gene, gene_direction = side)

gene_df <- gene_df %>% left_join(gene_direction_df, by = "Gene")

# ── Gene lists per direction ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# A gene belongs to the top (bottom) list when it has at least one scored position on that side.
# With a `gate_col` naming a logical column of the position table, only the rows where it is TRUE
# would count; no gate is used here.
.gate_genes <- function(pos_sub, gate_col = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(gate_col) && gate_col %in% names(pos_sub))
    pos_sub %>% filter(.data[[gate_col]] %in% TRUE) %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()
  else
    pos_sub %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()
}

gene_top_list <- .gate_genes(pos_top)
gene_bot_list <- .gate_genes(pos_bottom)

# Named list for looping in overlap sections
.caas_gates <- list(
  list(lbl = "All Positions", top = gene_top_list, bot = gene_bot_list)
)

# Background universe for gene-set overlap Fisher tests (RER / FADE / Accumulation
# Venn panels) - every gene that received a CAAS gene score in this run.
gene_universe_n <- nrow(gene_df)

# ── Normalisation helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Rank scaled to [0, 1] (ties averaged, NA kept).
rank_norm <- function(x) {
  r <- rank(x, na.last = "keep", ties.method = "average")
  (r - 1) / (max(r, na.rm = TRUE) - 1)
}

# ── Venn diagram helpers (used across RER / FADE / Accumulation tabs) ─────────
# Overlap enrichment is tested with a Fisher exact test (mathematically the
# hypergeometric test on a 2x2 table) against the full gene universe passed in
# `universe_n` - for gene-level overlaps this is nrow(gene_df), i.e. every gene
# that received a CAAS gene score in this run.
.venn_counts <- function(set_a, set_b, label_a, label_b, universe_n) {
  n_a  <- length(set_a); n_b <- length(set_b)
  n_ab <- length(intersect(set_a, set_b))
  n_only_a  <- n_a - n_ab
  n_only_b  <- n_b - n_ab
  n_neither <- universe_n - n_a - n_b + n_ab
  ft <- tryCatch(
    fisher.test(matrix(c(n_ab, n_only_b, n_only_a, n_neither), nrow = 2)),
    error = function(e) list(estimate = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_)
  )
  tibble(label_a, label_b, n_a, n_b, n_ab,
         n_only_a = n_only_a, n_only_b = n_only_b,
         odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), fisher_p = ft$p.value)
}
.draw_venn <- function(vc, col_a, col_b, title) {
  or_txt <- if (is.na(vc$odds_ratio)) {
    "OR = NA"
  } else {
    sprintf("OR = %.2f (Fisher p = %s)", vc$odds_ratio,
            formatC(vc$fisher_p, format = "e", digits = 1))
  }
  ggplot() +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin=0.05, xmax=0.65, ymin=0.22, ymax=0.85),
              fill=col_a, alpha=0.35, colour=col_a, linewidth=1) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin=0.35, xmax=0.95, ymin=0.22, ymax=0.85),
              fill=col_b, alpha=0.35, colour=col_b, linewidth=1) +
    annotate("text", x=0.20, y=0.535, label=vc$n_only_a, size=7, fontface="bold") +
    annotate("text", x=0.50, y=0.535, label=vc$n_ab,     size=7, fontface="bold", colour="grey20") +
    annotate("text", x=0.80, y=0.535, label=vc$n_only_b, size=7, fontface="bold") +
    annotate("text", x=0.20, y=0.15, label=vc$label_a, size=3.5, colour=col_a) +
    annotate("text", x=0.80, y=0.15, label=vc$label_b, size=3.5, colour=col_b) +
    annotate("text", x=0.50, y=0.93,
             label=sprintf("Shared: %d genes (%.0f%% of smaller set)",
                           vc$n_ab, 100 * vc$n_ab / max(min(vc$n_a, vc$n_b), 1)),
             size=3, colour="grey40") +
    annotate("text", x=0.50, y=0.02, label=or_txt, size=3, fontface="bold", colour="grey20") +
    ggtitle(title) + theme_void() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(-0.06, 1.02), clip = "off") +
    theme(plot.title  = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0, size=11, margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 4, b = 14, l = 4))
}
```

---

## Introduction

CAAS Scoring ranks the positions by their convergence score, then rolls that up to a per-gene score comparable against
independent evolutionary evidence.

1. **Position score (`CAAS_score`)**: the CAAS convergence score on the pair's
   Voronoi domain. Evidence that the convergence reflects independent origins,
   not shared ancestry. The biochemical groupings of the derived side
   (`biochem_groupings`) do not enter the score; they are described in the
   position-level enrichment report.

2. **Gene score (`gene_caas_score_top` / `_bottom`)**: the gene's strongest
   position, adjusted for how many positions the gene has, so genes are not
   rewarded simply for having more of them. Compared against:
   `r if (has_rand) "- **accum_p**: Exact hypergeometric p-value of CAAS accumulation (+ BH FDR accum_fdr)."`
   `r if (has_rer) "- RERConverge p-value and direction (accelerating / decelerating)."`
   - FADE: gene is significant per direction if any position has BF >= 100.

## Companion reports

This scoring report is the hub of the downstream enrichment suite. The reports below
are rendered as sibling HTML files in the same `html_reports/` directory and are
auto-annotated with the cross-module scoring signals (CAAS gates, top/bottom
percentiles, FADE, accumulation) produced here. A link is live only if the
corresponding module was part of this run. FADE and Accumulation do not run
their own FCS ranking; they appear there as cross-module corroboration flags.
Position Characterisation (PrimateAI-3D + COSMIC validation) is part of the
Position-level FCS report below.

```{r companion-reports, results='asis'}
.trait <- if (is.null(params$traitname) || !nzchar(params$traitname)) "unknown_trait" else params$traitname
.companions <- tibble::tribble(
  ~Report,                              ~File,
  "FCS - CAAS (this scoring run)",      sprintf("12.FCS_scoring_%s.html",    .trait),
  "FCS - RERconverge (+ p.perm)",       sprintf("12.FCS_rer_%s.html",        .trait),
  "AMI (DOMINO active modules)",        sprintf("13.AMI_analysis_%s.html", .trait),
  "Position-level FCS (+ Position Characterisation)", sprintf("14.Position_enrichment_report_%s.html", .trait),
  "COMPARE - cross-module overview",    sprintf("15.Comparison_report_%s.html",.trait)
)
cat(paste0("- [", .companions$Report, "](", .companions$File, ")", collapse = "\n"))
cat("\n")
```

## Scoring Methodology

This section documents the exact weighting and combination logic used to
produce every score in this report, so results can be interpreted and
reproduced independently of the pipeline code.

<details>
<summary><strong>Click to expand full methodology</strong></summary>

---

### Position-Level Score

`CAAS_score` is built from one evidence axis; `caas_row` and the position score (its `caas_row`) both lie in [0, 1]:

#### 1. Position evolution: `asr_path_score` (`asr_score`)

Core v3: `asr_path_score`, the CAAS convergence score on the pair's
Voronoi domain, built from the per-node ASR posteriors (full definitions in
[`docs/scoring_v3_core.md`](../../docs/scoring_v3_core.md)):

| Quantity | What it rewards |
|--------|-----------------|
| `asr_path_score` | mean over the K fixed Voronoi domains of the domain score: the PSS-weighted mean, over the species that represent the domain in the design's pairs, of their hypothesis scores (a hypothesis that does not detect the position counts 0). A hypothesis score is the noisy-OR independence of the domain with its same-residue partners (one minus the probability that the derived residue was already at their shared LCA) |
| `derived_agreement` | retained descriptor (not a score factor): changed pairs landing on the same derived residue per side |

(Core v3 removed the pairwise isolation factor `s_c^s * s_d^s` and the earlier
`independence` / `mrca_diversity` / `conservation_gate` axes from the score.)

#### 2. Position score and biochemical groupings

$$\text{caas\_row} = \text{asr\_path\_score}, \qquad \text{CAAS\_score} = \text{caas\_row}$$

(`caas_row` carries no permutation-rank phenotype factor, on the observed or the null side.) `biochem_groupings` lists the
groupings GS1-GS4 in which the derived residues of the position share one class that differs from the ancestral class,
and `is_biochem` says whether there is any; they are descriptors and do not enter any score. The position-level
enrichment report analyses them.


---

### Gene-Level Scores

#### gene_caas_top / gene_caas_bot

The gene's strongest position (`max(CAAS_score)`), calibrated against how many
positions the gene has: `F` is the genome-wide ECDF of `CAAS_score`
(direction-matched pool for the top/bottom variants) and `n` the gene's
position count.

$$\text{gene\_caas\_top} = F_{\text{top}}\big(\max(\text{CAAS\_score} \mid \text{change\_side} \in \{\text{top, both}\})\big)^{\,n_{\text{top}}}$$
$$\text{gene\_caas\_bot} = F_{\text{bottom}}\big(\max(\text{CAAS\_score} \mid \text{change\_side} \in \{\text{bottom, both}\})\big)^{\,n_{\text{bottom}}}$$

Without the exponent, a gene with more positions would score higher purely
from having more chances at a high maximum; raising the pool percentile to the
`n`th power removes that.

#### gene_accum_score (`accum_p`) *(optional)*

Exact hypergeometric p-value of CAAS accumulation.
Reported with BH FDR (`accum_fdr`); `accum_significant` is `accum_fdr < 0.05`.

#### RERConverge characterisation *(optional)*

`p.perm` when present, falling back to `p.adj` / `p.value` / `pvalue` / `pval`.
Direction from the sign of `Rho`: positive is accelerating, negative is
decelerating. Significance threshold `p.perm <= 0.05`.

#### FADE gene-level characterisation *(optional)*

A gene is FADE-significant per direction if it contains at least one position
with `max_site_bf >= 100`.

---

### Empirical activity and adjusted evidence

Genes use the empirical p.gen obtained from their own permulation null. Positions use p.emp (detects and exceeds, pooled over sides). Activity lists use the configured nominal threshold; the same tables and AMI networks highlight BH-adjusted significance. All tested genes remain in the continuous FCS ranking. No fraction of the score distribution is selected.

</details>

---


## CAAS Permulation Null {.tabset}

The permulation re-labels the phylogeny `N` times and re-runs discovery and ASR
scoring under each null labeling. Each cycle is one complete null realisation:
the positions it discovers are its candidate set, exactly as the real run's
discovered set is the observed candidate set. The comparisons below and the
position-level `p.emp` are built term-for-term like the observed pipeline, from
the same `N` cycles.

The formal per-pathway `p.perm` (ASR axis) is in the companion **FCS** report.

```{r pos-null-setup, eval=has_pos_null}
.src_pal <- c(Observed = "#E15759", Null = "grey55")

# The null is read as its summaries, not as a table of every detection (tens of millions of rows at 1000 cycles):
#   cycle_summary.tsv  cycle, direction (global = one entry per position, its best side; top, bottom: position-side
#                      entries), n scored entries and n_genes that have one; every null cycle has a row, the ones that detect
#                      nothing with n = 0
#   cycle_hist.tsv     cycle, direction, bin, n: the scores in bins of 0.01 (bin = floor(100 * score)); empty bins are absent
.null_sum  <- readr::read_tsv(params$null_summary_file, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = "ccii")
.null_hist <- readr::read_tsv(params$null_hist_file, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = "ccii")

.obs_pos <- pos_df %>%
  mutate(CAAS_score = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(CAAS_score))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CAAS_score), side %in% c("top", "bottom")) %>%
  transmute(Gene, Position, side, score = CAAS_score)

# Every null cycle is in the summary, so the number of cycles is the number of its distinct cycles.
.null_cycles <- unique(.null_sum$cycle)
.n_cyc       <- max(length(.null_cycles), 1L)
.n_pad       <- 0L
.dirs        <- c("global", "top", "bottom")

# global: one entry per position, its best side, as in the undirected gene score.
.best_side <- function(d, by) {
  if (nrow(d) == 0) return(d)
  d %>% group_by(across(all_of(by))) %>%
    summarise(score = if (any(is.finite(score))) max(score[is.finite(score)]) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop")
}
.sets <- list(
  global = list(obs = .best_side(.obs_pos, c("Gene", "Position"))),
  top    = list(obs = filter(.obs_pos, side == "top")),
  bottom = list(obs = filter(.obs_pos, side == "bottom")))

# Per-cycle value of a summary column, in the order of the cycles (a cycle with no entry is 0).
.null_per_cycle <- function(direction, column = "n") {
  d <- .null_sum[.null_sum$direction == direction, ]
  v <- d[[column]][match(.null_cycles, d$cycle)]
  v[is.na(v)] <- 0
  v
}
# Histogram counts of a direction: bins 0..100 by cycles.
.null_bins <- function(direction) {
  m <- matrix(0, nrow = 101, ncol = length(.null_cycles))
  d <- .null_hist[.null_hist$direction == direction, ]
  m[cbind(d$bin + 1L, match(d$cycle, .null_cycles))] <- d$n
  m
}
```

```{r pos-null-na, eval=!has_pos_null, results='asis'}
cat("_No position-level permulation null available for this run",
    " (`cycle_summary.tsv` absent or empty)._\n\n")
```

### Detected positions vs null

```{r pos-null-excedance, eval=has_pos_null, fig.height=4.8, fig.width=10}
# The null scores are binned at 0.01, so a score counts at the threshold of its own bin: the grid is the one of the observed
# scores and of the highest null bin.
.null_top_bin <- max(c(0L, .null_hist$bin[.null_hist$n > 0]))
.max_s <- max(c(.obs_pos$score[is.finite(.obs_pos$score)], (.null_top_bin + 1) / 100))
.grid  <- seq(0, max(0.01, ceiling(100 * .max_s) / 100), by = 0.01)
.cnt   <- function(x) {
  x_fin <- x[is.finite(x)]
  rev(cumsum(rev(tabulate(findInterval(x_fin, .grid), length(.grid)))))  # N(score >= grid)
}
# N(score >= grid) of every null cycle from its histogram
.cnt_hist <- function(bins) {
  h <- bins[seq_len(min(nrow(bins), length(.grid))), , drop = FALSE]
  h <- rbind(h, matrix(0, nrow = length(.grid) - nrow(h), ncol = ncol(h)))
  apply(h, 2, function(col) rev(cumsum(rev(col))))
}
.exc <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(.dirs, function(d) {
  m <- .cnt_hist(.null_bins(d))
  tibble::tibble(direction = d, s = .grid, obs = .cnt(.sets[[d]]$obs$score),
                 med = apply(m, 1, median),
                 lo  = apply(m, 1, quantile, .025),
                 hi  = apply(m, 1, quantile, .975))
})) %>% mutate(direction = factor(direction, levels = c("global", "top", "bottom")))

.fl <- 0.5   # log axis floor for counts of 0
ggplot(.exc, aes(s)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(lo, .fl), ymax = pmax(hi, .fl), fill = "null, 95% of cycles"), alpha = .4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pmax(med, .fl), colour = "null, median cycle"), linewidth = .7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pmax(obs, .fl), colour = "observed"), linewidth = .9) +
  scale_y_log10() + facet_wrap(~direction) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("null, median cycle" = "grey35", observed = "#E15759"), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("null, 95% of cycles" = "grey65"), name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Positions with CAAS Score >= s: observed vs one permulated cycle",
       subtitle = sprintf("%d null cycles | top, bottom: position-side rows | global: positions (best side)", .n_cyc),
       x = "score threshold s", y = "positions (log10)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

At each threshold `s`, the red line is the number of positions of the run with `CAAS_score >= s`. The grey line is
the same count in one permulated cycle (median over cycles) and the band holds 95% of the cycles. A red line above
the band means the run has more positions at that score than almost any null labeling. The number of detections of
a cycle depends on its own contrasts, so the cycles differ widely in volume, and the band is the range of that
variation and not a confidence interval.

### Composition of detections

Each plot compares what the null detects (pooling its cycles) with what the run detects. Similar shapes mean that the
null produces detections of the same kind as the run, so that a difference in the excedance plot comes from how many
positions are detected and not from what a detection looks like.

```{r pos-null-comp-data, eval=has_pos_null}
# The null detections, from the histogram of its scores pooled over the cycles: one point per bin (its centre) carrying the
# number of detections of the bin as weight. The run's detections are its own scores.
.null_pooled <- function(d) {
  h <- .null_hist[.null_hist$direction == d, ] %>% group_by(bin) %>% summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
  tibble::tibble(score = (h$bin + 0.5) / 100, weight = as.numeric(h$n))
}
.comp <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(.dirs, function(d)
  dplyr::bind_rows(tibble::tibble(direction = d, source = "Observed", score = .sets[[d]]$obs$score, weight = 1),
                   dplyr::mutate(.null_pooled(d), direction = d, source = "Null")))) %>%
  mutate(direction = factor(direction, levels = c("global", "top", "bottom")),
         source    = factor(source, levels = c("Null", "Observed")))
.theme_p <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

#### Score of the detected positions (score > 0)

```{r pos-null-score-density, eval=has_pos_null, fig.height=3.8, fig.width=10, results='asis'}
.comp_pos <- .comp %>% filter(score > 0, weight > 0)
if (nrow(.comp_pos) > 0) {
  p_dens <- ggplot(.comp_pos, aes(score, weight = weight, colour = source, fill = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = .25, adjust = 1.2) + facet_wrap(~direction, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = .src_pal) + scale_fill_manual(values = .src_pal) +
    labs(x = "CAAS Score", y = "density", colour = NULL, fill = NULL) +
    .theme_p + theme(legend.position = "top")
  print(p_dens)
} else {
  cat("_No positions with score > 0 available._\n\n")
}
```

#### Detections with score 0

```{r pos-null-zeros, eval=has_pos_null, fig.height=3.5, fig.width=6}
.comp %>% group_by(direction, source) %>% summarise(zeros = weighted.mean(score == 0, weight), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(direction, zeros, fill = source)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = .8), width = .7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = .src_pal) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "share of detections", fill = NULL) + .theme_p
```

### Top and bottom balance

```{r pos-null-topbottom, eval=has_pos_null, fig.height=4.2, fig.width=10}
.rt <- .null_per_cycle("top"); .rb <- .null_per_cycle("bottom")
.o_t <- nrow(.sets$top$obs); .o_b <- nrow(.sets$bottom$obs)
.min_rows <- 20   # the ratio is unstable in cycles with a handful of detections
.ok <- .rt >= .min_rows & .rb >= .min_rows
p_ratio <- ggplot(tibble::tibble(r = log2(.rb[.ok] / .rt[.ok])), aes(r)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey65", colour = "grey35") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(.o_b / .o_t), colour = "#E15759", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "bottom / top detections per cycle", x = "log2(bottom / top)", y = "cycles",
       subtitle = sprintf("cycles with >= %d detections on each side (%d of %d)", .min_rows, sum(.ok), .n_cyc)) + .theme_p
p_sc <- ggplot(tibble::tibble(top = pmax(.rt, 1), bottom = pmax(.rb, 1)), aes(top, bottom)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(alpha = .3, size = 1, colour = "grey35") +
  geom_point(data = tibble::tibble(top = .o_t, bottom = .o_b), colour = "#E15759", size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "top vs bottom detections per cycle", x = "top (log10)", y = "bottom (log10)") + .theme_p
gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_ratio, p_sc, ncol = 2)
```

The left plot is the ratio of detections on the two sides in each cycle, and the red line is the run. The right
plot has one point per cycle: points along the diagonal mean that a cycle that detects much on one side detects much
on the other; the run is in red.

### Volume and heterogeneity

#### Volume per cycle

```{r pos-null-volume, eval=has_pos_null, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=10}
.vol_n <- list(`rows, top`    = .null_per_cycle("top"),
               `rows, bottom` = .null_per_cycle("bottom"),
               `positions, global` = .null_per_cycle("global"),
               `genes with a detection` = .null_per_cycle("global", "n_genes"))
.vol_o <- c(`rows, top` = .o_t, `rows, bottom` = .o_b, `positions, global` = nrow(.sets$global$obs),
            `genes with a detection` = dplyr::n_distinct(.obs_pos$Gene))
.vol_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(.vol_n), function(m) tibble::tibble(metric = m, value = .vol_n[[m]]))) %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = names(.vol_n)))
ggplot(.vol_long, aes(pmax(value, 1))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey65", colour = "grey35") +
  geom_vline(data = tibble::tibble(metric = factor(names(.vol_o), levels = names(.vol_n)), v = unname(.vol_o)),
             aes(xintercept = v), colour = "#E15759", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() + facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "per cycle (log10)", y = "cycles") + .theme_p
```

Each histogram is the quantity over the null cycles, and the red line is the run.

#### Heterogeneity between cycles

```{r pos-null-heterogeneity, eval=has_pos_null, fig.height=3.8, fig.width=10}
.het <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(.vol_n)[1:3], function(m) {
  v <- pmax(.vol_n[[m]], 1); tibble::tibble(metric = m, fold = log2(v / median(v)), obs = log2(max(.vol_o[[m]], 1) / median(v)))
})) %>% mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = names(.vol_n)[1:3]))
ggplot(.het, aes(fold)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey65", colour = "grey35") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = obs), colour = "#E15759", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~metric) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(ifelse(x >= 0, "x", "1/x"), signif(2^abs(x), 2))) +
  labs(x = "detections relative to the median cycle", y = "cycles") + .theme_p
```

```{r pos-null-heterogeneity-table, eval=has_pos_null}
knitr::kable(dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(.vol_n), function(m) {
  v <- .vol_n[[m]]; o <- .vol_o[[m]]
  tibble::tibble(metric = m, min = min(v), q05 = quantile(v, .05), median = median(v), q95 = quantile(v, .95), max = max(v),
                 `q95 / q05` = quantile(v, .95) / max(quantile(v, .05), 1), CV = sd(v) / mean(v),
                 observed = o, `cycles >= observed` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(v >= o)))
})), digits = 2, caption = "Detections per null cycle: spread of the null and position of the run")
```

The plot shows how far a cycle departs from the median cycle, in folds, and the red line is where the run falls.
The table gives the same spread in numbers and the share of null cycles that detect at least as much as the run.

### Null universe

```{r null-universe-na, eval=!.file_ok(params$null_universe_file), results='asis'}
cat("_No null-universe summary for this run (`null_universe_summary.tsv` absent: no position-level null given to SCORING)._\n\n")
```

```{r null-universe-text, eval=.file_ok(params$null_universe_file), results='asis'}
.nu <- readr::read_tsv(params$null_universe_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
.nu_val  <- function(m) { v <- .nu$value[.nu$metric == m]; if (length(v)) v[[1]] else NA_real_ }
.nu_note <- function(m) { v <- .nu$note[.nu$metric == m]; if (length(v) && !is.na(v[[1]])) v[[1]] else "" }
.nu_n <- function(x) if (is.finite(x)) format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE) else "NA"

cat(paste0(
  "The position p-values compare each observed position with a null that can only produce the positions the ",
  "permulation labelings reach. The universe U of the position family (`p.adj_bh`, `p.adj_bh_fact`, and the pool of ",
  "the classes of `p.emp_fact`) is the null-positive positions inside the tested set plus every observed positive ",
  "position, the same set the position enrichment uses as background.\n\n",
  "- **N**: ", .nu_n(.nu_val("N_cycles")), " cycles (", .nu_note("N_cycles"), "; ",
  .nu_n(.nu_val("N_cycles_present_in_null")), " leave a row in the null file)\n",
  "- **Null-positive positions**: ", .nu_n(.nu_val("null_positive_positions_all")), " in total, ",
  .nu_n(.nu_val("null_positive_positions_in_universe")), " in U (", .nu_note("null_positive_positions_in_universe"), ")\n",
  "- **Observed positive positions**: ", .nu_n(.nu_val("observed_positive_positions")), "\n",
  "- **Observed positions the null never scored**: ", .nu_n(.nu_val("observed_unseen_positions")),
  sprintf(" (%.1f%%)\n", 100 * .nu_val("fraction_unseen")),
  "- **|U|**: ", .nu_n(.nu_val("universe_size")), " positions\n\n",
  "An unseen position is a position no null cycle scored. It keeps p = 1/(N + 1) and stays in the BH families and ",
  "in the enrichment background: the unseen fraction diagnoses whether N cycles are enough for the null to reach ",
  "the positions that can be scored, and demotes nothing.\n\n"))
```

```{r null-universe-curve, eval=.file_ok(params$null_universe_file), fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
if (nrow(.nu_curve) > 0) {
  ggplot(.nu_curve, aes(x = cycles, y = value)) +
    geom_line(colour = "grey40") +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, colour = "#E15759") +

         subtitle = "distinct null-positive positions of U seen in the first k cycles",

}
```

### Null harvest

How many permulated labelings the harvest drew, how many it kept, why it discarded the others, and how much of the
candidate space the selection rule leaves out. These are the figures of the harvest that built the null, not of the
scored data.

```{r null-harvest-na, eval=!.file_ok(params$perm_harvest_file), results='asis'}
cat("_No `permulation_harvest.tsv` is available for this run: the harvest was made before the audit was recorded, ",
    "or its summary was not carried through (`--caas_perm_harvest_file`)._\n\n")
```

```{r null-harvest-setup, eval=.file_ok(params$perm_harvest_file)}
.hv <- readr::read_tsv(params$perm_harvest_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
if (!"x" %in% names(.hv)) .hv$x <- NA_real_
if (!"value" %in% names(.hv)) .hv$value <- NA_real_
.hv <- .hv %>% mutate(
  section = as.character(section),
  key     = as.character(key),
  x       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)),
  value   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(value))
)
.hv_get <- function(sec, key) { v <- .hv$value[.hv$section == sec & .hv$key == key]; if (length(v)) v[[1]] else NA_real_ }
.hv_draws <- .hv_get("run", "draws"); .hv_t1 <- .hv_get("run", "tier1"); .hv_t2 <- .hv_get("run", "tier2")
.hv_pool <- .hv_get("run", "pool"); .hv_match <- isTRUE(.hv_get("settings", "match_pss") == 1)
.hv_tol <- .hv_get("settings", "match_pss_tol"); .hv_K <- .hv_get("settings", "target_pairs")
.hv_rej <- .hv %>% filter(section == "reject") %>% transmute(reason = key, draws = value)
.theme_h <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
```

#### Draws and rejections

```{r null-harvest-funnel, eval=.file_ok(params$perm_harvest_file), fig.height=3.6, fig.width=10}
.fun <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(outcome = "accepted, Tier 1 (all pairs independent)", draws = .hv_t1, kind = "accepted"),
  tibble::tibble(outcome = "accepted, Tier 2 (one pair below Dunn 1)", draws = .hv_t2, kind = "accepted"),
  .hv_rej %>% transmute(outcome = reason, draws, kind = "rejected")) %>%
  filter(draws > 0) %>% mutate(share = draws / .hv_draws, outcome = factor(outcome, levels = rev(outcome)))
ggplot(.fun, aes(draws, outcome, fill = kind)) +
  geom_col(width = .7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", format(draws, big.mark = ","), 100 * share)), hjust = -0.05, size = 3.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(accepted = "grey55", rejected = "#E15759"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, .35))) +
  labs(x = sprintf("draws (of %s)", format(.hv_draws, big.mark = ",")), y = NULL) + .theme_h
```

```{r null-harvest-run-table, eval=.file_ok(params$perm_harvest_file)}
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(
  `draws` = .hv_draws, `Tier 1` = .hv_t1, `Tier 2` = .hv_t2,
  `acceptance` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * (.hv_t1 + .hv_t2) / .hv_draws),
  `kept in the pool` = .hv_pool, `target pairs (K)` = .hv_K,
  `budget escalations` = .hv_get("run", "escalations")), caption = "Permulation harvest")
.dm <- .hv %>% filter(section == "design") %>% select(round = x, key, value) %>% tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = value)
if (nrow(.dm)) knitr::kable(.dm %>% transmute(round, `candidate target` = target, `candidates drawn` = candidates,
  `reach the observed number of hypotheses` = reach, rate = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * reach / candidates)),
  caption = "Design matching: candidates that reach the number of FOP hypotheses of the run")
```

A draw is rejected when it cannot give `K` mutually independent pairs, or, with the PSS matching, when the pairs it
can give do not follow the PSS of the observed pairs. Tier 1 draws beyond the pool, and the candidates that do not
reach the number of hypotheses of the run, are drawn and not kept.

#### What the PSS rule discards

```{r null-harvest-tolerance, eval=.file_ok(params$perm_harvest_file) && .hv_match && any(.hv$section == "tolerance"), fig.height=3.8, fig.width=7}
.tol <- .hv %>% filter(section == "tolerance", key == "complete_within_tol") %>% transmute(tol = x, accepted = value / .hv_draws)
.cmp <- .hv_get("tolerance", "complete") / .hv_draws
ggplot(.tol, aes(tol, accepted)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .cmp, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = .8, colour = "#4E79A7") + geom_point(size = 1.4, colour = "#4E79A7") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .hv_tol, colour = "#E15759", linewidth = .8) +
  annotate("text", x = .hv_tol, y = 0, label = sprintf(" tolerance %g", .hv_tol), hjust = 0, vjust = -0.6, colour = "#E15759", size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = max(.tol$tol), y = .cmp, label = "draws with K independent pairs", hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.2, colour = "grey30") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "relative PSS tolerance of each pair", y = "draws accepted") + .theme_h
```

```{r null-harvest-tolerance-na, eval=.file_ok(params$perm_harvest_file) && !(.hv_match && any(.hv$section == "tolerance")), results='asis'}
cat("_This harvest did not match the PSS profile of the observed pairs (`perm_match_pss` off, or count trait), so no pair was discarded by it._\n\n")
```

The curve is the share of all draws that would be accepted at each tolerance; the dotted line is the share that has
`K` independent pairs at all, which no tolerance can exceed. The gap between the chosen tolerance and that line is
what the PSS rule discards.

#### Candidate pairs and capacity

```{r null-harvest-capacity, eval=.file_ok(params$perm_harvest_file) && any(.hv$section == "capacity"), fig.height=3.4, fig.width=7}
.cap <- .hv %>% filter(section == "capacity") %>% select(draw = x, key, value) %>% tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = value) %>%
  filter(is.finite(capacity))
.obs <- c(pool_gated = .hv_get("observed", "pool_gated"), pool_ungated = .hv_get("observed", "pool_ungated"), capacity = .hv_get("observed", "capacity"))
ggplot(.cap, aes(capacity)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, boundary = 0, fill = "grey65", colour = "grey35") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = .obs[["capacity"]], colour = "#E15759", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(x = "independent pairs the trait can give (capacity)", y = "sampled draws",
       title = "Capacity of the null traits (grey) and of the run (red)") + .theme_h
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(
  quantity = c("independent pairs (capacity)", "candidate pairs after the PSS gate", "candidate pairs before the PSS gate", "pairs the PSS gate discards"),
  run = c(.obs[["capacity"]], .obs[["pool_gated"]], .obs[["pool_ungated"]], .obs[["pool_ungated"]] - .obs[["pool_gated"]]),
  `null median` = c(median(.cap$capacity), median(.cap$pool_gated), median(.cap$pool_ungated), median(.cap$pool_ungated - .cap$pool_gated)),
  `null q05` = c(quantile(.cap$capacity, .05), quantile(.cap$pool_gated, .05), quantile(.cap$pool_ungated, .05), quantile(.cap$pool_ungated - .cap$pool_gated, .05)),
  `null q95` = c(quantile(.cap$capacity, .95), quantile(.cap$pool_gated, .95), quantile(.cap$pool_ungated, .95), quantile(.cap$pool_ungated - .cap$pool_gated, .95))),
  digits = 1, caption = sprintf("Pool and capacity, run against a sample of %d null draws", nrow(.cap)))
```

The run assembles its pairs until the Dunn index stops it, so its `K` is the capacity of its trait: the most mutually
independent pairs its candidate pool gives. A null trait with a larger capacity than `K` has pairs that a draw of exactly
`K` pairs leaves out; this is the choice the PSS matching makes explicit, by taking among them the ones whose PSS follows
the run. The PSS gate keeps the top fraction of the candidate pairs of each trait (`top_pct`); the table gives how many pairs it
discards in the run and in the null (the pool sizes hardly vary between permulations, because the permulated trait
keeps the values of the observed one). Capacity is computed on a sample of the draws, not on all.

### Design comparability

A null cycle is a permulated labeling, and the number of positions it detects depends on the design of its contrasts:
pairs of species that are more divergent have more substitutions to share, so they detect more. This panel compares the
canonical pairs (H1) of each null cycle with those of the run, and shows how the detections of a cycle depend on them.
If the run lies in the body of the null in these quantities, the null is comparable to it; if it lies in a tail, the
volume comparison of the previous tabs must be read with that in mind.

```{r pos-null-design, eval=has_pos_null && .file_ok(params$perm_manifest_file) && .file_ok(params$hypotheses_pairs_file), fig.height=6.5, fig.width=10}
.man <- readr::read_tsv(params$perm_manifest_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
.hp1 <- readr::read_tsv(params$hypotheses_pairs_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(hypothesis_id == "H1")
# |delta| of the canonical pairs from the trait values of the manifest when the run predates the design columns
.mean_abs <- function(f, b) mean(abs(as.numeric(strsplit(f, ",")[[1]]) - as.numeric(strsplit(b, ",")[[1]])))
if (!"mean_abs_diff" %in% names(.man) && all(c("fg_values", "bg_values") %in% names(.man)))
  .man$mean_abs_diff <- mapply(.mean_abs, .man$fg_values, .man$bg_values)
.des_obs <- c(mean_distance = mean(.hp1$distance), mean_pss = mean(.hp1$pss_score), mean_abs_diff = mean(.hp1$abs_diff))
.des_lab <- c(mean_distance = "mean patristic distance of the pairs", mean_pss = "mean PSS of the pairs", mean_abs_diff = "mean |trait difference| of the pairs")
.des_cols <- intersect(names(.des_lab), names(.man))
.des_cols <- .des_cols[vapply(.des_cols, function(m) any(is.finite(.man[[m]])), logical(1))]

.des_long <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(.des_cols, function(m) tibble::tibble(metric = .des_lab[[m]], value = .man[[m]]))) %>%
  filter(is.finite(value)) %>% mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = unname(.des_lab[.des_cols])))
p_des <- ggplot(.des_long, aes(value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "grey65", colour = "grey35") +
  geom_vline(data = tibble::tibble(metric = factor(unname(.des_lab[.des_cols]), levels = levels(.des_long$metric)), v = unname(.des_obs[.des_cols])),
             aes(xintercept = v), colour = "#E15759", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  labs(title = "Canonical pairs per null cycle (grey) and in the run (red)", x = NULL, y = "cycles") + .theme_p

# Detections of each cycle against the distance of its pairs
if ("mean_distance" %in% .des_cols) {
  .pos_cyc <- tibble::tibble(cycle = .null_cycles, positions = as.integer(.null_per_cycle("global")))
  .sc <- .man %>% left_join(.pos_cyc, by = "cycle") %>% mutate(positions = dplyr::coalesce(positions, 0L))
  .rho <- suppressWarnings(cor(.sc$mean_distance, .sc$positions, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"))
  p_sc2 <- ggplot(.sc, aes(mean_distance, pmax(positions, 1))) +
    geom_point(alpha = .3, size = 1, colour = "grey35") +
    geom_point(data = tibble::tibble(mean_distance = .des_obs[["mean_distance"]], positions = max(nrow(.sets$global$obs), 1)), colour = "#E15759", size = 3) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(title = sprintf("Positions detected per cycle vs distance of its pairs (Spearman %.2f)", .rho),
         x = "mean patristic distance of the pairs", y = "positions detected (log10)") + .theme_p
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_des, p_sc2, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 1.1))
} else {
  print(p_des)
}

.des_tab <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(.des_cols, function(m) {
  v <- .man[[m]]; o <- .des_obs[[m]]
  tibble::tibble(quantity = .des_lab[[m]], run = o, `null median` = median(v, na.rm = TRUE), q05 = quantile(v, .05, na.rm = TRUE),
                 q95 = quantile(v, .95, na.rm = TRUE), `cycles >= run` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * mean(v >= o, na.rm = TRUE)))
}))
knitr::kable(.des_tab, digits = 3, caption = "Design of the canonical pairs: the run against the null cycles")
```

When the permulations are harvested with `perm_match_pss`, the PSS of the canonical pairs of each cycle follows the PSS of
the run, so the PSS histogram is centered on the red line by construction; the distance and the trait difference of the
pairs are not constrained and show whether that matching is enough for the null to resemble the run.

### Null Draw Diversity & Redundancy

Evaluation of whether the harvested null pool represents diverse, independent evolutionary configurations
or collapses to recurring sets of contrast pairs. In trees with finite tip taxa or restricted trait variations,
some contrast configurations can be drawn more than once. This panel audits:
- **Uniqueness & Redundancy**: How many of the $N$ accepted cycles represent unique contrast drawings vs duplicate re-draws.
- **Multiplicity Distribution**: How many cycles occur as singletons ($1\times$) vs multiples ($2\times, 3\times, \dots$).
- **Normalized Shannon Entropy**: $H_{\text{norm}} \in [0, 1]$, where $1.0$ indicates perfect uniformity across all draws, while values $< 0.8$ would indicate clustering in few phenotypic configurations.
- **Pairwise Contrast Overlap (Jaccard similarity)**: Average fraction of contrast pairs shared between distinct null cycles.

```{r pos-null-diversity, eval=.file_ok(params$perm_manifest_file), fig.height=5, fig.width=10, results='asis'}
.man_div <- readr::read_tsv(params$perm_manifest_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Derive draw signature: prefer explicit draw_signature or species, fallback to trait values
if ("draw_signature" %in% names(.man_div) && any(nzchar(.man_div$draw_signature))) {
  .sigs <- .man_div$draw_signature
} else if (all(c("fg_species", "bg_species") %in% names(.man_div))) {
  .sigs <- paste(.man_div$fg_species, .man_div$bg_species, sep = " vs ")
} else if (all(c("fg_values", "bg_values") %in% names(.man_div))) {
  .sigs <- paste(.man_div$fg_values, .man_div$bg_values, sep = " vs ")
} else {
  .sigs <- .man_div$cycle
}

.n_tot <- nrow(.man_div)
.tab_sigs <- table(.sigs)
.n_uniq <- length(.tab_sigs)
.n_dup <- .n_tot - .n_uniq
.dup_rate <- if (.n_tot > 0) .n_dup / .n_tot else 0.0
.max_mult <- if (length(.tab_sigs)) max(.tab_sigs) else 0L

# Effective number of distinct draws (inverse Simpson index): the size of an equally redundant pool of
# equally frequent draws; N when every draw is unique, 1 when one draw fills the pool.
.p_sig <- as.numeric(.tab_sigs) / max(.n_tot, 1L)
.eff_draws <- if (.n_tot > 0) 1 / sum(.p_sig^2) else 0

# Multiplicity counts
.mult_counts <- tibble::as_tibble(.tab_sigs, .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
  rlang::set_names(c("signature", "multiplicity")) %>%
  mutate(multiplicity = as.integer(multiplicity))

.mult_summary <- .mult_counts %>%
  count(multiplicity, name = "n_unique_draws") %>%
  mutate(
    total_cycles_accounted = multiplicity * n_unique_draws,
    pct_of_pool = round(100 * total_cycles_accounted / .n_tot, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(multiplicity)

# KPI summary table
.div_kpis <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Total null cycles in pool (N)",
             "Unique contrast configurations",
             "Duplicate cycles",
             "Uniqueness rate",
             "Redundancy rate",
             "Max multiplicity (most frequent draw)",
             "Effective number of distinct draws"),
  Value = c(format(.n_tot, big.mark = ","),
            format(.n_uniq, big.mark = ","),
            format(.n_dup, big.mark = ","),
            sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * (1 - .dup_rate)),
            sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * .dup_rate),
            sprintf("%d cycles (%.2f%% of pool)", .max_mult, 100 * .max_mult / max(.n_tot, 1L)),
            sprintf("%s (%.1f%% of N; bounds the resolution of an empirical p)",
                    format(round(.eff_draws, 1), big.mark = ","), 100 * .eff_draws / max(.n_tot, 1L)))
)
print(knitr::kable(.div_kpis, caption = "Null Draw Diversity & Redundancy Summary"))
cat("\n\n")

# Multiplicity bar plot
p_mult <- ggplot(.mult_summary, aes(x = factor(multiplicity), y = total_cycles_accounted, fill = factor(multiplicity))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%d cycles\n(%.1f%%)", total_cycles_accounted, pct_of_pool)),
            vjust = -0.3, size = 3.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis", end = 0.85) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.2))) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Draw Multiplicities in Null Pool",
       subtitle = sprintf("%s total cycles | %s unique configurations (%.1f%%)",
                          format(.n_tot, big.mark = ","), format(.n_uniq, big.mark = ","), 100 * (1 - .dup_rate)),
       x = "Multiplicity (times configuration was drawn)",
       y = "Cycles in pool") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))

# Pairwise Jaccard overlap on a sample of draws (if pairs are separated by ;)
if ("draw_signature" %in% names(.man_div) && any(grepl(";", .man_div$draw_signature))) {
  .draw_pairs <- strsplit(.man_div$draw_signature, ";")
  .sample_idx <- if (.n_tot > 200) sample(.n_tot, 200) else seq_len(.n_tot)
  .sub_pairs <- .draw_pairs[.sample_idx]
  .m_n <- length(.sub_pairs)
  .jacc_vals <- numeric(0)
  for (i in seq_len(.m_n - 1)) {
    for (j in (i + 1):.m_n) {
      u <- union(.sub_pairs[[i]], .sub_pairs[[j]])
      int <- intersect(.sub_pairs[[i]], .sub_pairs[[j]])
      if (length(u) > 0) .jacc_vals <- c(.jacc_vals, length(int) / length(u))
    }
  }
  if (length(.jacc_vals) > 0) {
    .jacc_df <- tibble::tibble(jaccard = .jacc_vals)
    p_jacc <- ggplot(.jacc_df, aes(x = jaccard)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4E79A7", colour = "grey30", alpha = 0.85) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = median(.jacc_vals), colour = "#E15759", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
      labs(title = "Pairwise Contrast Jaccard Overlap (Sample of Null Draws)",
           subtitle = sprintf("Median pair sharing: %.2f%% (dashed red)", 100 * median(.jacc_vals)),
           x = "Jaccard similarity between two draws", y = "Draw pairs") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
    gridExtra::grid.arrange(p_mult, p_jacc, ncol = 2)
  } else {
    print(p_mult)
  }
} else {
  print(p_mult)
}
cat("\n\n")
```

```{r pos-perm-p-setup}
# p.emp is the position-level permulation p: the "detects AND exceeds score"
# permulation p, pooled to (Gene, Position) over the max-over-sides axis, with
# its BH adjustment (p.adj_bh). p.emp_fact is its factorized form, with p.adj_bh_fact.
# scoring_compute.R writes them into position_scores.tsv
# whenever the counters of the null (--null_counters) are given.
.valid_p <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pos_df$p.emp))
.valid_p <- .valid_p[is.finite(.valid_p) & .valid_p > 0]
has_p_emp <- length(.valid_p) > 0
# p.emp is add-one smoothed, so its minimum is 1/(N + 1). A value at that floor is reported as "< 1/N" (with 1000
# permulations "<0.001"), the convention of Saputra et al. 2021; the TSV keeps the number. N is read from the floor.
.p_floor <- if (has_p_emp) min(.valid_p) else NA_real_
.n_perm  <- if (!is.na(.p_floor) && is.finite(.p_floor) && .p_floor > 0) round(1 / .p_floor) - 1 else NA_real_
.fmt_p <- function(p) vapply(p, function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !is.finite(x)) return(NA_character_)
  if (is.finite(.n_perm) && !is.na(.p_floor) && is.finite(.p_floor) && x <= .p_floor * (1 + 1e-9)) {
    return(sprintf("<%s", format(1 / .n_perm, digits = 3)))
  }
  format(signif(x, 3), scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)
}, character(1))
```

```{r p-emp-header, eval=has_p_emp, results='asis'}
cat("### p.emp\n\n")
n_val <- sum(!is.na(pos_df$p.emp) & is.finite(pos_df$p.emp))
n_tot <- nrow(pos_df)
n_floor <- if (!is.na(.p_floor) && is.finite(.p_floor)) {
  sum(!is.na(pos_df$p.emp) & is.finite(pos_df$p.emp) & pos_df$p.emp <= .p_floor * (1 + 1e-9))
} else {
  0L
}
has_fact <- all(c("p.emp_fact", "p.adj_bh_fact") %in% names(pos_df))
min_fact <- if (has_fact) suppressWarnings(min(pos_df$p.emp_fact[is.finite(pos_df$p.emp_fact)], na.rm = TRUE)) else NA_real_

cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "The position p-values are informative: no threshold or significance call is applied to them.\n\n",
  "`p.emp` is the empirical permulation p of the position: the proportion of the N permuted-labeling cycles ",
  "that detect the position (on either phenotype side) and give it a `CAAS_score` at least as high as the ",
  "observed one, counting the observed run as one more cycle, (k + 1)/(N + 1). Its minimum is 1/(N + 1), ",
  "reported as `< 1/N`. A position with an observed score of 0 has p.emp = 1. `p.adj_bh` is its Benjamini-Hochberg ",
  "adjustment over one test per position of the universe U of the null-universe tab (the null-positive positions ",
  "inside the tested set plus every observed positive position; positions the null detects and the observed data ",
  "do not enter at p = 1).\n\n",
  "`p.emp_fact` is the same quantity factorized: the proportion of cycles that detect the position times the ",
  "proportion of the detections of positions of a similar propensity to be detected (the cycles that detect ",
  "them) that reach its score. It is not limited by the 1/(N + 1) floor, so it orders positions that `p.emp` ",
  "ties. `p.adj_bh_fact` is its BH adjustment over the same family.\n\n",
  "- **Scored positions with p.emp**: %d/%d (%.1f%%)\n",
  "- **At the permulation floor (p.emp %s)**: %d positions\n",
  "- **Smallest p.emp_fact**: %s\n\n"),
  n_val, n_tot, 100 * n_val / max(1, n_tot),
  .fmt_p(.p_floor), n_floor,
  if (has_fact && is.finite(min_fact)) format(min_fact, digits = 3) else "NA"))
```

## Empirical evidence {.tabset}

Nominal activity and BH-adjusted significance refer to the same tested universe. A position appearing on both sides has one pooled p.emp and is counted once globally. Missing empirical evidence remains unavailable.

### Counts

```{r evidence-counts}
.evidence_col <- function(df,n,default=NA_real_) if(n %in% names(df)) df[[n]] else rep(default,nrow(df))
.counts <- list()
for(rk in c("global","top","bottom")) {
  suffix <- if(rk=="global") "" else paste0("_",rk)
  gp <- .evidence_col(gene_df,paste0("caas_p.gen",suffix))
  gn <- .evidence_col(gene_df,paste0("caas_nominal",suffix),FALSE) %in% TRUE
  ga <- .evidence_col(gene_df,paste0("caas_adjusted",suffix),FALSE) %in% TRUE
  pp <- if(rk=="global") pos_df[!duplicated(paste(pos_df$Gene,pos_df$Position)),] else pos_df[pos_df$side==rk,]
  .counts[[rk]] <- tibble::tibble(ranking=rk,genes_with_p=sum(!is.na(gp)),genes_nominal=sum(gn),genes_BH=sum(ga),positions_with_p=sum(!is.na(pp$p.emp)),positions_nominal=sum(pp$caas_nominal %in% TRUE),positions_BH=sum(pp$caas_adjusted %in% TRUE))
}
knitr::kable(dplyr::bind_rows(.counts))
```

### Gene evidence

```{r calibrated-gene-tables, results='asis'}
for(rk in c("global","top","bottom")) {
  suffix <- if(rk=="global") "" else paste0("_",rk)
  x <- gene_df
  x$`p.gen` <- .evidence_col(x,paste0("caas_p.gen",suffix))
  x$`p.gen.adj` <- .evidence_col(x,paste0("caas_p.gen.adj",suffix))
  x$nominal <- .evidence_col(x,paste0("caas_nominal",suffix),FALSE) %in% TRUE
  x$adjusted <- .evidence_col(x,paste0("caas_adjusted",suffix),FALSE) %in% TRUE
  x <- x[order(x$p.gen,x$p.gen.adj,na.last=TRUE),]
  cols <- intersect(c("Gene","p.gen","p.gen.adj","nominal","adjusted","rer_min_pval","rer_perm_padj","rer_significant","rer_significant_fdr","fade_max_bf_top","fade_max_bf_bottom","accum_p","accum_fdr"),names(x))
  cat("\n#### ",rk,"\n\n",sep="")
  print(knitr::kable(head(x[,cols,drop=FALSE],200),caption="First 200 rows for display; complete evidence is published as TSV. BH hits are marked adjusted."))
}
```

### Cross-method gene overlap

```{r empirical-overlap}
.rows <- list()
for(rk in c("global","top","bottom")) {
 suffix <- if(rk=="global") "" else paste0("_",rk)
 cp <- .evidence_col(gene_df,paste0("caas_p.gen",suffix))
 for(tool in c("RER","FADE","Accumulation")) {
  measured <- switch(tool,RER=!is.na(.evidence_col(gene_df,"rer_min_pval")),FADE=!is.na(.evidence_col(gene_df,"fade_max_bf_top"))|!is.na(.evidence_col(gene_df,"fade_max_bf_bottom")),Accumulation=!is.na(.evidence_col(gene_df,"accum_p")))
  for(level in c("nominal","adjusted")) {
   ca <- .evidence_col(gene_df,paste0("caas_",level,suffix),FALSE) %in% TRUE
   other <- switch(tool,RER=.evidence_col(gene_df,if(level=="nominal")"rer_significant" else "rer_significant_fdr",FALSE) %in% TRUE,FADE=(.evidence_col(gene_df,"fade_significant_top",FALSE) %in% TRUE)|(.evidence_col(gene_df,"fade_significant_bottom",FALSE) %in% TRUE),Accumulation=.evidence_col(gene_df,"accum_significant",FALSE) %in% TRUE)
   if(tool=="RER" && rk!="global")other<-other & (.evidence_col(gene_df,"rer_rho") * if(rk=="top")1 else -1)>0
   if(tool=="FADE" && rk!="global")other<-.evidence_col(gene_df,paste0("fade_significant_",rk),FALSE) %in% TRUE
   ok <- !is.na(cp)&measured; ca<-ca[ok];other<-other[ok]
   m <- matrix(c(sum(ca&other),sum(ca&!other),sum(!ca&other),sum(!ca&!other)),2)
   pv <- if(length(ca)&&all(rowSums(m)>0)&&all(colSums(m)>0)) fisher.test(m)$p.value else NA_real_
   .rows[[length(.rows)+1L]] <- tibble::tibble(ranking=rk,tool=tool,call=level,shared_tested_universe=length(ca),CAAS=sum(ca),other=sum(other),overlap=sum(ca&other),fisher_p=pv)
  }
 }
}
.overlap <- dplyr::bind_rows(.rows)
.overlap$fisher_BH <- p.adjust(.overlap$fisher_p,"BH")
readr::write_tsv(.overlap,file.path(params$output_dir,"gene_evidence_overlap.tsv"))
knitr::kable(.overlap)
```

```{r fade-site-annotations, include=FALSE}
.load_fade_sites <- function(path) {
  if (!.file_ok(path)) return(NULL)
  # FADE_JSON_TO_CSV writes a comma-separated file. The reader is chosen by the delimiter on the
  # header line, not by the extension, so a tab-separated table also loads.
  hdr <- tryCatch(readLines(path, n = 1L, warn = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  df <- if (length(hdr) && grepl(",", hdr) && !grepl("\t", hdr)) {
    read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else {
    read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  }
  names(df) <- tolower(names(df))
  if (ncol(df) < 2) return(NULL)  # malformed / single-column: nothing to join
  
  if (!"gene" %in% names(df)) names(df)[1] <- "gene"
  if ("site" %in% names(df)) {
    df$position <- as.integer(df$site) - 1L
  } else if ("position" %in% names(df)) {
    df$position <- as.integer(df$position)
  } else {
    df$position <- as.integer(df[[2]]) - 1L
  }
  
  bf_col <- intersect(c("max_site_bf", "max_bf", "bayes_factor", "bf"), names(df))[1]
  if (is.na(bf_col)) {
    df$max_site_bf <- 0
  } else {
    df$max_site_bf <- as.numeric(df[[bf_col]])
  }
  
  aa_col <- intersect(c("top_target_aa", "target_aa", "aa"), names(df))[1]
  if (!is.na(aa_col)) {
    df$top_target_aa <- as.character(df[[aa_col]])
  } else {
    df$top_target_aa <- NA_character_
  }
  
  bias_col <- intersect(c("fade_biased", "biased"), names(df))[1]
  if (!is.na(bias_col)) {
    df$fade_biased <- as.logical(df[[bias_col]])
  } else {
    df$fade_biased <- df$max_site_bf >= 100
  }
  
  df %>%
    select(Gene = gene, Position = position, max_site_bf, top_target_aa, fade_biased)
}
fade_top_df <- .load_fade_sites(params$fade_site_top_file)
fade_bot_df <- .load_fade_sites(params$fade_site_bot_file)
```

## Genomic Accumulation {.tabset}

`r if (!has_genomic) "> **Note:** Genomic coordinates (gene_ensembl_file) are not available for this run - genomic accumulation skipped."`

```{r genomic-setup, eval=has_genomic}
# Join gene_df with genomic coordinates.
gene_genomic <- gene_df %>%
  select(Gene, gene_caas_score, gene_caas_top, gene_caas_bot, n_positions) %>%
  inner_join(genomic_raw, by = "Gene") %>%
  # Standardise chromosome labels (remove "chr" prefix if present)
  mutate(
    chr_label = sub("^chr", "", chr),
    # Order chromosomes numerically then X, Y, MT
    chr_num   = suppressWarnings(as.integer(chr_label)),
    chr_order = dplyr::case_when(
      !is.na(chr_num)       ~ chr_num,
      chr_label == "X"      ~ 23L,
      chr_label == "Y"      ~ 24L,
      chr_label %in% c("MT","M") ~ 25L,
      TRUE                  ~ 26L
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(chr_order, gene_mid)

# Build a cumulative x-axis offset per chromosome for a stitched Manhattan view
chr_offsets <- gene_genomic %>%
  group_by(chr_order, chr_label) %>%
  summarise(chr_max = max(gene_end, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(chr_order) %>%
  mutate(offset = cumsum(lag(chr_max, default = 0L)) + (chr_order - 1L) * 5e6L)

gene_genomic <- gene_genomic %>%
  left_join(chr_offsets %>% select(chr_order, offset, chr_label), by = c("chr_order", "chr_label")) %>%
  mutate(manhattan_x = gene_mid + offset)

chr_label_positions <- chr_offsets %>%
  left_join(gene_genomic %>% group_by(chr_order) %>%
              summarise(mid_x = mean(manhattan_x, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "chr_order")
```

```{r window-helper, eval=has_genomic}
# Helper: tile chromosomes into non-overlapping windows of win_size bp.
# Each gene/position is assigned to the window containing its genomic midpoint.
# Returns a dataframe with one row per window, summarising mean and max score.
make_window_accum <- function(df, score_col,
                               win_size = params$window_size_bp) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      chr_order  = integer(),
      chr_label  = character(),
      win_id     = double(),
      win_start  = double(),
      win_end    = double(),
      win_mid    = double(),
      n_genes    = integer(),
      mean_score = double(),
      max_score  = double(),
      genes      = character()
    ))
  }
  df %>%
    mutate(
      win_id    = floor(gene_mid / win_size),
      win_start = win_id * win_size,
      win_end   = win_start + win_size - 1L,
      win_mid   = win_start + win_size / 2L
    ) %>%
    group_by(chr_order, chr_label, win_id, win_start, win_end, win_mid) %>%
    summarise(
      n_genes    = dplyr::n(),
      mean_score = {
        vals <- .data[[score_col]]
        vals <- vals[!is.na(vals) & is.finite(vals)]
        if (length(vals) > 0) mean(vals) else 0.0
      },
      max_score  = {
        vals <- .data[[score_col]]
        vals <- vals[!is.na(vals) & is.finite(vals)]
        if (length(vals) > 0) max(vals) else 0.0
      },
      genes      = paste(unique(Gene), collapse = ", "),
      .groups    = "drop"
    )
}

# Stitch window midpoints onto the cumulative chromosome x-axis (same offsets
# as gene_genomic so windows align with the per-gene manhattans above).
stitch_windows <- function(win_df) {
  if (nrow(win_df) == 0) {
    return(win_df %>% mutate(win_x = numeric(), chr_even = logical()))
  }
  win_df %>%
    left_join(chr_offsets %>% select(chr_order, offset), by = "chr_order") %>%
    mutate(win_x = win_mid + offset,
           chr_even = chr_order %% 2 == 0)
}
```

### CAAS Score Manhattan

```{r genomic-manhattan-caas, eval=has_genomic, fig.height=5, fig.width=14}
gene_genomic <- gene_genomic %>%
  mutate(
    chr_even      = chr_order %% 2 == 0,
    caas_log      = -log10(pmax(caas_p.gen,1e-300)),
    caas_top_log  = -log10(1 - pmin(replace_na(gene_caas_top, 0), 0.9999)),
    caas_bot_log  = -log10(1 - pmin(replace_na(gene_caas_bot, 0), 0.9999))
  )
caas_log_thr <- -log10(params$evidence_p_threshold)

p_gene_man <- ggplot(gene_genomic,
       aes(x = manhattan_x, y = caas_log,
           colour = chr_even, size = n_positions)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE)

if (is.finite(caas_log_thr)) {
  p_gene_man <- p_gene_man +
    geom_hline(yintercept = caas_log_thr, linetype = "dashed",
               colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6)
}

top_gene_labels <- gene_genomic %>%
  filter(!is.na(caas_log) & is.finite(caas_log) & caas_log > 0 & is.finite(manhattan_x)) %>%
  slice_max(caas_log, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE)

if (nrow(top_gene_labels) > 0) {
  p_gene_man <- p_gene_man +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = top_gene_labels,
      aes(label = Gene), size = 2.2, max.overlaps = 15,
      show.legend = FALSE, colour = "black"
    )
}

p_gene_man <- p_gene_man +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE"=.tableau10[1], "TRUE"=.tableau10[2]), guide="none") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "N positions", range = c(0.5, 5)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = chr_label_positions$mid_x,
    labels = chr_label_positions$chr_label,
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Gene CAAS Score - Manhattan View",
    subtitle = sprintf("%d genes | dashed = nominal empirical threshold", nrow(gene_genomic)),
    x = "Chromosome", y = "-log10(p.gen)"
  ) +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(face="bold"),
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=14), axis.text.y=element_text(size=14),
        axis.title=element_text(size=14), legend.text=element_text(size=12),
        panel.grid.major.x=element_blank())

print(p_gene_man)
```

### CAAS Window Accumulation (Positions)

`r if (!has_genomic) "> **Note:** Genomic coordinates not available - position window accumulation skipped."`

```{r pos-window-accum, eval=has_genomic, fig.height=5, fig.width=14, results='asis'}
# Tile position-level CAAS scores into genomic windows.
# pos_genomic is built in the pos-caas-manhattan-setup chunk above.
# We use the same pos_chr_offsets to align x-coordinates with the gene-level plots.
win_size_label <- if (params$window_size_bp >= 1e6) {
  sprintf("%g Mb", params$window_size_bp / 1e6)
} else {
  sprintf("%g kb", params$window_size_bp / 1e3)
}

pos_wins <- pos_genomic %>%
  rename(Gene = Gene) %>%
  make_window_accum("CAAS_score", win_size = params$window_size_bp)

if (nrow(pos_wins) == 0) {
  cat("_No scored positions mapped to genomic windows._\n\n")
} else {
  pos_wins <- pos_wins %>%
    left_join(pos_chr_offsets %>% select(chr_order, offset), by = "chr_order") %>%
    mutate(n_positions = n_genes,
           win_x       = win_mid + offset,
           chr_even    = chr_order %% 2 == 0,
           mean_log    = -log10(1 - pmin(replace_na(mean_score, 0), 0.9999)),   # position score in [0, 1]
           max_log     = -log10(1 - pmin(replace_na(max_score, 0),  0.9999)))

  # Label the top windows as genomic regions, not gene names.
  # Ranked by n_positions (window density) rather than mean_log, to surface the
  # regions with the most positions rather than the highest mean score.
  top_pos_wins <- pos_wins %>%
    filter(!is.na(max_log) & is.finite(max_log) & max_log > 0 & is.finite(win_x)) %>%
    slice_max(n_positions, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(region_label = sprintf("chr%s:%0.1f-%0.1f Mb", chr_label, win_start / 1e6, win_end / 1e6))

  p_pos_accum <- ggplot(pos_wins, aes(x = win_x, y = mean_log, fill = chr_even)) +
    geom_col(width = params$window_size_bp * 0.9, alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_point(aes(y = max_log, colour = chr_even), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE)

  if (nrow(top_pos_wins) > 0) {
    p_pos_accum <- p_pos_accum +
      ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
        data = top_pos_wins,
        aes(y = max_log, label = sprintf("%s\n(%d positions)", region_label, n_positions)),
        size = 2.2, max.overlaps = 10, colour = "black",
        show.legend = FALSE
      )
  }

  p_pos_accum <- p_pos_accum +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = .tableau10[1], "TRUE" = .tableau10[2]),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = .tableau10[3], "TRUE" = .tableau10[4]),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = pos_chr_label_positions$mid_x,
      labels = pos_chr_label_positions$chr_label,
      expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = sprintf("Position-Level CAAS Score - %s Window Accumulation", win_size_label),
      subtitle = sprintf("Bars = mean | Points = max | %d windows across %d chromosomes",
                         nrow(pos_wins), length(unique(pos_wins$chr_order))),
      x = "Chromosome", y = "-log10(1 - mean CAAS score)"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title         = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )

  print(p_pos_accum)
}
```

```{r pos-window-accum-table, eval=has_genomic && exists("pos_wins") && nrow(pos_wins) > 0}

    select(chr_label, win_start, win_end, n_positions, mean_score, max_score, mean_log) %>%
    mutate(
      win_start  = format(win_start, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
      win_end    = format(win_end,   big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
      mean_score = round(mean_score, 4),

    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_positions)) %>%
    rename(chr = chr_label, start = win_start, end = win_end,

           `-log10(1-mean)` = mean_log),

    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",

  )
)
```

## Supplementary Exports

```{r supplementary-tsv-export}
# Build a wide supplementary table joining position_scores with FADE data.
# Exported as position_scores_annotated.tsv alongside the report outputs.

supp_df <- pos_df

# Join FADE data: use the direction-matched FADE table for each position
if (has_fade_pos) {
  fade_combined <- bind_rows(
    if (!is.null(fade_top_df)) fade_top_df %>% mutate(fade_direction = "TOP")    else NULL,
    if (!is.null(fade_bot_df)) fade_bot_df %>% mutate(fade_direction = "BOTTOM") else NULL
  )
  if (nrow(fade_combined) > 0) {
    # Per-side rows: a "both" position is two rows; take TOP FADE by priority
    fade_for_join <- fade_combined %>%
      mutate(fade_direction_priority = if_else(fade_direction == "TOP", 1L, 2L)) %>%
      group_by(Gene, Position) %>%
      slice_min(fade_direction_priority, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(Gene, Position,
             fade_max_site_bf     = max_site_bf,
             fade_top_target_aa   = top_target_aa,
             fade_biased,
             fade_direction)
    supp_df <- supp_df %>% left_join(fade_for_join, by = c("Gene", "Position"))
  }
}

readr::write_tsv(supp_df,
  file.path(params$output_dir, "position_scores_annotated.tsv"))

cat(sprintf("Exported position_scores_annotated.tsv: %d rows, %d columns\n",
            nrow(supp_df), ncol(supp_df)))
cat(sprintf("Columns: %s\n", paste(names(supp_df), collapse = ", ")))
```

```{r summary-stats}
# Fixed counts shown in the summary table, not derived from the data.

  Metric = c(

    "CAAS Score (median)", "Position nominal empirical threshold",
    "Gene CAAS TOP (median)", "Gene nominal empirical threshold",
    "FADE site-level analysis available",
    "FADE gene-level analysis available",
    "Accumulation score available", "RERConverge available",
    "Genomic coordinates available"
  ),
  Value = c(
    format(nrow(pos_df), big.mark = ","),
    format(nrow(gene_df), big.mark = ","),
    as.character(n_components),
    as.character(n_gene_components),
    sprintf("%.4f", median(pos_df$CAAS_score, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%.4f", params$evidence_p_threshold),
    sprintf("%.4f", median(gene_df$gene_caas_top, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%.4f", params$evidence_p_threshold),
    ifelse(has_fade_pos,     "Yes", "No"),
    ifelse(has_fade_gene,    "Yes", "No"),
    ifelse(has_accum_score,  "Yes", "No"),
    ifelse(has_rer,          "Yes", "No"),
    ifelse(has_genomic,      "Yes", "No")
  )
)
```
